repositories.name: WhisperAI-Llama3.1-ASR-Chatbot-for-food-in-SG
repositories.description: Personalized local food personal assistant chatbot in Singapore, fine tuned with Singapore locations. Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and transcription using WhisperAI, fed into Llama 3.1 through Groq client.

repositories.name: Dengue-Predictor-and-Project-Wolbachia-Study

repositories.name: NLP-Mental-Health-text-identification
repositories.description: Using NLP to identify online forum posts showing signs of mental distress. Models compared include Multinomial Naive Bayes, XGBoost, RoBERTa and GPT-2.

repositories.name: Future-weather-predictions-for-Ops-and-Resource-Planning

repositories.description: Using Linear Regression and its regularized counterparts to predict the housing prices in Singapore and comparing their performances with a gradient boosted model, XGBoost
